verdict.rationale: vLLM's official CLI reference documents a command that starts the vLLM OpenAI-compatible API server, so launching the local model server from the command line is a first-party capability. The CLI docs also include related serving tooling such as TTFT/throughput statistics and benchmarks. No item shows how to stop the server, and only a one-line description is given, so the start/stop lifecycle is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented stop/shutdown command or behavior, detailed CLI usage examples (flags, model selection), independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI start/stop workflow.
